name: Region-conditioned low-rank memory with native-history training
status: Prospective exploratory CV; freeze before the full-sequence engineering gate and accuracy run
method: Use Microsoft's pinned author LoRA Linear for three rank-4 residual experts in each of four native memory-attention layers. Mix each token's content-dependent residual by its own stored-prediction soft region memberships, then use native key/value projections, decoder and writer. Keep all native frames, tokens, positional encodings and pointers. No confidence gating, added threshold, frame-quality selection or second read.
global_control: Same initialization, parameter count, training clips and compute; replace within-frame role maps by each frame's own mean memberships.
training_rule: Identical fresh LoRA initialization, folds, seed, author-sampled five-frame blocks, optimizer, losses and 140 updates/arm/fold as Run134. Replace only the fresh clip-local GT prompt context by the same targets captured from each training video's original native trajectory. Preserve original video indices, length, temporal positions and native selected frames/pointers. Start each block from strictly past native teacher memory; subsequent four target reads use the trained arm's own differentiable predicted writes. The first sampled frame is context, not a new prompt. This is truncated teacher-prefix training, not full-video on-policy training. Final-epoch weights only; no diagnostic weights reused.
engineering_gate: Fresh complete seq2/seq3 native and zero-adapter trajectories must match archived native predictions and current stored outputs bit-for-bit. Also replay one fixed author-sampled cached block per gate sequence with exact native/zero masks, scores, intermediate writes and losses. Nonzero propagation in both arms must observe allfour layers, instance ownership and paired native key/pointer/frame schedules. Full CV requires this exact source inventory and cache completion. Stop on integrity failure, not unexpected accuracy.
capacity_prerequisite: Run136 native-history capacity gate and independent audit must pass; Run137 native-history cache must complete all21 sequences/2012 post-prompt targets with matching native hashes, source inventory and checkpoint/manifest/config. Cache gate includes exact native, zero and trained block replay and gradients.
native_reference: Reuse validated Run 118 MedSAM2 native predictions for all 21 promptable sequences. Require matching checkpoint, manifest, repository revision, frame hashes and prompt coverage. No third-party baseline reruns.
primary: Within-sequence mean present-frame Dice, followed by equal-sequence mean; report all 21 sequences including zero-Dice failures, excluding seq1/seq7 only because no prompt is available.
secondary: IoU, official DAVIS Boundary F, GT-empty false alarms/denominators, censored overlap re-detection, actual spatial/pointer key counts and measured runtime. Missing archived native runtime remains unavailable.
inference: Two fixed contrasts: regional minus native and regional minus global control. Whole-sequence bootstrap 95% intervals with 10000 resamples and paired Wilcoxon with Holm across these two contrasts. Patient independence remains unverified.
meaningful_screen: For both contrasts require mean Dice gain at least 0.01, at least 14 of 21 sequence wins, positive lower confidence limit, Holm-adjusted p below 0.05 and no extra pooled GT-empty false alarms. Report failures without redefining success. This remains exploratory after repeated PolypGen development; later independent confirmation and another seed are needed.
cache: Load only training-sequence teacher banks in each fold. Cached inference predictions never provide supervision; later GT is loss-only. Validation uses full original videos with the original first-positive prompt, own predicted memory and no cached teacher bank. No new GT prompts within training blocks.
amendment: Run134 did not meet its meaningful Dice screen. Read-only inspection found fresh five-frame context differs from native inference history and pointer time normalization. SAM2 AppendixD.2.2 motivates examining context mismatch; the cached truncated prefix is a project adaptation, not the author training recipe. Keep all other settings and success criteria unchanged. This is exploratory after repeated PolypGen development.
